## Checklist

- [ ] Public API changes are reflected in `docs/api`.
- [ ] New or changed examples are reflected in `examples/README.md` and `docs/case` or `docs/guide`.
- [ ] Persistence format, remote protocol, profile defaults, schema names, and built-in tools are reflected in the docs when changed.
- [ ] `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools\check_docs.ps1` passes.
